search_scope: presence of runner trust-root environment variables
finding: No actual CI runner signer, administrator-provisioned allowed-signers file, separately delivered trust-root pin, or actual signed receipt was found in the inspected scope. This is a bounded search finding.
required_external_steps: CI/admin provisions a dedicated signer outside the repository.
Public key is installed in a restricted allowed-signers file on verifier host.
Allowed-signers SHA-256 pin is delivered through an independent channel.
Actual runner signs receipt bound to exact commit/tree/suite/environment/log bytes.
Independent verifier checks signer, image, command, hashes, exit code, summary and pin.
Independent reviewer verifies trust provisioning and runner provenance.
acceptance: Remain blocked until all steps are evidenced.
